integrity: Exact uniform proof; finite-field computations are corroborative only. The nearest source supplies the general Mayer path framework and local chain generators. No independent novelty certification or scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs with at least one edge and girth at least five, bidirected arcs, complex coefficients and primitive cubic root; degree zero through three only. No homology classification above degree three.
title: Low-degree equivariant cubic Mayer homology of bidirected graphs of girth at least five
